purpose: Capability registry for literature discovery, completeness auditing, TOC retrieval, and website synchronization. The primary literature task must select the newest stable compatible capability on main before each fetch run.
fingerprintMethod: sha256 UTF-8 of six newline-joined "<label>=<blobSha>" lines in this exact order: literatureAudit, literatureWorkflow, journalRegistry, completenessGuard, tocCollector, publisherFallback; no trailing newline

literatureAudit.validation: GitHub Actions run 37201854938 succeeded on main after the RSC/Chem repair. The audit queried from 2026-09-19 catch-up, preserved partial Crossref publication dates as unknown instead of fabricating January/day 1, surfaced Chem 9, Chemical Science 78, and Green Chemistry 41 source records, reported criticalSourceFailures=0 and sourceFamilyGaps=0, and retained sourceCoverageAnomalies instead of silently collapsing raw records.
literatureAudit.comparisonToPriorStable: Supersedes the older stable discovery implementation that could report verifiedThrough catch-up without widening actual source queries and could coerce partial Crossref dates such as [2026] to 2026-01-01. The repaired implementation makes catch-up real at the query layer, preserves created/deposit provenance, retains date precision, and makes raw-to-union collapse observable.
literatureAudit.semanticImpact: Higher discovery recall and safer date semantics. New DOI candidates are exposed to semantic review only; this promotion does not admit literature, change scope decisions, or advance verifiedThrough.

literatureWorkflow.validation: Run 37201854938 executed this workflow on main: capability guard passed, DOI-union audit completed, artifact upload succeeded, and paired latest/compact snapshots were persisted.
literatureWorkflow.semanticImpact: Keeps the existing push-triggered audit path and fixed publication schedule while persisting repaired discovery snapshots.

journalRegistry.validation: 16 canonical target journals are centralized. Chem, Chemical Science, CCS Chemistry, Science Advances, and Green Chemistry use activeFrom=2026-09-19; JOC uses activeFrom=2026-09-22; earlier journals retain 2026-07-01.
journalRegistry.semanticImpact: The repair does not change target journals or activation dates; it makes the configured RSC/Chem coverage actually observable.

completenessGuard.validation: Passed in repair validation run 37201431750 and main audit runs 37201754206/37201854938. It now guards real catch-up query widening, independent created-date provenance, raw-to-union collapse detection, and rejection of fabricated dates from partial Crossref fields.
completenessGuard.semanticImpact: CI fails if catch-up becomes report-only again, if partial dates are coerced to fake calendar dates, or if nonzero raw source candidates silently collapse to zero.

websiteMediaSync.validation: GitHub Pages run 35418810801 succeeded with galleryDois=463, workerItems=463, finalRecords=407, failures=0 and figure metadata=716
websiteMediaSync.semanticImpact: Downstream media synchronization coverage only. Adds rolling-supplement.json to media sync; does not alter literature discovery, inclusion decisions, or upstream TOC retrieval.

recentMediaRepair.validation: GitHub Actions run 35419525431 completed successfully on the Sep 18-19 reviewed literature update; it prepared 30 recent gaps, attempted direct publisher retrieval, ran the Worker fallback, verified inventory, and triggered Pages refresh.
recentMediaRepair.effectiveness: Publisher direct retrieval remained blocked by ACS/Wiley 403 and Nature IDP for most targets; the workflow is operationally stable but currently low-yield without an authenticated browser/VPN source.
recentMediaRepair.semanticImpact: TOC/media repair only. Does not change literature discovery or inclusion decisions.
